title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Place of Contract Signing after Contract Assignment

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on How to Determine the Place of Contract Conclusion After Contract Assignment
Fa (Jing) Fu [1986] No. 30
Higher People's Court of Liaoning Province:
Your request, Liaofa (Jing) Qing [1986] No. 12, has been received. Upon study, we are of the opinion that: the contract for purchase and sale of vest bag making machines signed between Jiamusi Light Industrial Machinery Factory (supplier) and Fushun Embroidery Craft Factory (buyer) in Jiamusi City, after negotiation between the parties and Fushun Packaging General Factory, was unanimously agreed to be transferred by Fushun Embroidery Craft Factory to Fushun Packaging General Factory for performance. After the transfer formalities were completed in Fushun, a new legal relationship arose and the original legal relationship was extinguished. The place where the contract for assignment was jointly signed and sealed, i.e., Fushun City, shall be the place of contract conclusion for this case. The place of shipment stipulated in the assignment contract is Jiamusi City, hence the place of contract performance remains in Jiamusi City. Pursuant to Article 23 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), both the Xinfu District People's Court of Fushun City and the Dongfeng District People's Court of Jiamusi City have jurisdiction over this case. According to the documents, the Xinfu District People's Court of Fushun City accepted the case one day earlier than the Dongfeng District People's Court of Jiamusi City; moreover, the subject matter of this case is located in Fushun City, and the focus of dispute between the parties is the product quality issue. Therefore, pursuant to Article 31 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), this case shall be accepted by the Xinfu District People's Court of Fushun City.
This is in reply.
October 30, 1986
